savedToolId.description: The ID of the saved tool the request matches, from the catalogue (GEN-18).

interfacePart.description: What the request asks of the interface, in its own words; null if nothing.

dataPart.description: What the request asks of the data (records to add, change or remove); null if nothing.

behaviorChange.description: True when the request changes how the tool behaves, as in 'guests arrive in groups'.

lookOnly.description: True when the request only changes how the tool looks, not what it does.

targetsCurrentTool.description: True when the request is about the tool open now.

language.description: The request's language as a BCP 47 tag, such as en or pt-BR (GEN-15).

name.description: A short name for one separate thing the request asks for.

request.description: The part of the request it comes from, as written.

features.description: The separate things the request asks for, used to decide on two passes (GEN-17).
